t: A library of Pre-K to grade 2 lesson plans for Bee-Bot and Blue-Bot floor robots.
steps: Find the Bee-Bot lessons on the Terrapin website.
Start the 30 day trial or buy a site license.
Print a lesson PDF and the optional 6 by 6 Card Mat.
Charge the Bee-Bots or open the online emulator.
Run one lesson with a small group.
